finding.topTitle: Re: Scheduling: Atlas Vector Search sync (Sydney + Dublin)

summary: On 5 nights in the last two weeks, around 11:17 PM, you spent about 21 minutes bouncing between Gmail, Google Calendar and Codex, switching 8 times each night.

workflow.title: Schedule across time zones for you
workflow.problem: Scheduling by hand with Sydney, Dublin and New York, and the meeting still lands at 12:00 AM.
workflow.trigger: A scheduling thread arrives in Gmail, like "Re: Scheduling: Atlas Vector Search sync (Sydney + Dublin)"

steps.label: Read the thread
steps.detail: Pull out who needs to meet, how long, and the times already proposed

steps.label: Find the overlap
steps.detail: Check free and busy time for Sydney, Dublin and New York, inside working hours

steps.label: Draft the reply
steps.detail: Offer three slots in each person’s time zone, in your voice

steps.label: Ask you once
steps.detail: Show the draft and the slots before anything is sent

steps.label: Book and confirm
steps.detail: Send the invite, and flag it when 12:00 AM is the only overlap

proactive: Stop booking you at 12:00 AM: propose the next morning’s overlap instead
Keep a standing slot that works for every time zone
Answer “does this time work?” threads while you sleep
workflow.saves: about 21 minutes and 8 app switches a night
